Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to provide a plot of land in extent of 69.9 hectares situated in the  Grama Niladhari Division of Ralmaduwa in the Wanathwilluwa Divisional Secretary's Division in the Puttlam District, to H.V.A. Farms (Private Limited) for an Environment Friendly Organic Fruits and Vegetable Cultivation Project on a 30 year long term lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Abolition of the Import Control Fee of 1% of CIF value on import of tea for re-export
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The budget proposals of 2017 has proposed to abolish the import control fee of 1% of CIF value on import of tea for re-export. Accordingly, taking into consideration the joint proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries and Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, the Cabinet granted approval to abolish the said import control fee and amend it by removing the Item of Serial No.46 of Schedule 1 in the Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1953/28 of 2016-02-11 and decided that a permit charge of Rs.1,000/- be levied for every permit issued, for import of tea for re-export.

description: Establishment of a University College in the Trincomalee District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - Presently, 13 public sector vocational training centres function in the Trincomalee District conducting 54 training courses in diverse fields while around 24 training courses are conducted in the vocational training centres operated by the private sector. Approximately, 2,200 students have undergone training at these public sector training centres. At present, these training centres provide only the vocational training courses of NVQ level 3 and 4 and therefore, to follow the training courses of NVQ level 5 and 6 the students have to attend the University Colleges in either Anuradhapura or Jaffna. Under these circumstances, it has been found that the establishment of a University College in the Trincomalee District is an absolute need. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to establish a University College at Kinya in the Trincomalee District at a cost of Rs.434 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to establish an Offshore Sri Lankan Rupee (LKR) Bond Programme by the International Finance Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The International Finance Corporation (IFC) affiliated to the World Bank has submitted a proposal to issue offshore Sri Lankan Rupee Bonds and to utilize such proceeds in her own IFC projects implemented  by Sri Lanka. By this the country will benefit since it would signal confidence in the Sri Lanka economy: flow new foreign investors into the country overtime: promote alternative funding sources for the Sri Lanka bond issuers and attract more USD flows into Sri Lanka. The matter has been taken up at the Committee meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management and the implementation of the proposal has been recommended. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the proposal subject to obtaining the formal approval of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the other relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Divi Udana' Programme for Interest Subsidy Loan Schemes - 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Budget Proposal of 2017 proposed to implement loan schemes at concessionary interest rates with the aim of improving the agriculture sector,  and encouraging the production economy as well as the social welfare of the country. Accordingly, measures have been taken to implement 08 loan schemes at concessionary interest rates.  The Cabinet noted the facts presented to the Cabinet by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media,  to the effect that the whole programme which has been named as the 'Divi Udana' Interest Subsidy Loan Schemes Programme has been implemented since 31st March 2017, that the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media has entered into agreements for the successful implementation of the programme through the Commercial Banks and that measures have been taken to conduct awareness programmes to educate the general public of the subsidy loan schemes programme, through both the printed and electronic media.

description: Conducting a Feasibility study on the construction of Wee Oya Reservoir in the Kelani river basin and the Yatimahana Reservoir in the Ma Oya basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body:
- Presently, the National Water Supply & Drainage Board experiences difficulties in the intake of the required quantities of water for water treatment plants operated from the Ma Oya and the Kelani River during the periods of dry weather. This situation will adversely affect the planning and implementation of the water supply schemes anticipated even in the future. 

As a solution to the issue, it has been planned to construct the proposed MCM 19 capacity Wee Oya Reservoir by the Kelani River and the proposed MCM 12.7 capacity Yatimahana Reservoir by the Ma Oya.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for conducting a feasibility study on the proposed upstream reservoir construction to Ms. Mahaweli Consultancy Bureau (Pvt.) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Annual Bus Fares - 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body:
- The National Transport Commission has been vested with the authority of the revision of bus fares in consultation with the Bus Operators' Associations and all stakeholders.  The proposals pertaining to the revision of bus fares for the year 2017 has been prepared based on the data published by the Central Bank  and taking into consideration the changes pertaining to the cost variable to the bus operating cost. 

Accordingly, with due consideration to the proposal made by the National Transport Commission, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation to increase the existing bus fares by 6.28% with effect from 01st July 2017 and to revise the present minimum bus fare of Rs.9/- to be Rs.10/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing and Upgrading of the Institute of Engineering Technology, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet on 14th March 2017 has granted approval for the award of the contract of the project for Enhancing and Upgrading of the Institute of Engineering Technology, Katunayake.  The Government of Austria has agreed to provide the sum of 9.5 Euro million required for the implementation of the project as an interest free soft loan through a Bank of Austria. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Niroshan Perera, the Acting Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations with the Raiffeisen International Bank of Austria and subsequently, to enter into loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of Operating Theatres and Intensive Care Units under the Austrian Soft Loan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - 	A project has been designed to provide Anesthetic Machines, Ventilators for ICU, Blood Gas Analyzers, Endoscopes, Operation Theaters and  Networks of Mobile Lights to the identified government hospitals with the objective of enhancing the health facilities of the people.  The Government of Austria has agreed to provide a soft loan of 9.58 Euro million for the purpose through a Bank of Austria. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Niroshan Perera, the Acting Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into Agreements to obtain the said loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report 2016 of the Ministry of Finance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with section 13 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.03 of 2003 the Minister of Finance and Mass Media is required to release the 'Final Budgetary Position Report' at the end of the financial year to Parliament and to the Public. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media to table the said Report in Parliament, prepared inclusive of the information regarding the relevant Government Fiscal Activity, containing thirteen (13) Chapters, the Government Financial Statement and the Auditor General's Report on such Statement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the National Disaster Relief Service Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - Further strengthening of the National Disaster Relief Service Centre (NDRSC) is imperative to respond immediately to situations emerging as a result of natural disasters as well as human activity to be faced continuously and also to carry out efficiently the relief services and re-establishment activities. For this purpose, the Disaster Relief Service Mechanism in the National, District and Divisional Level should be strengthened by taking measures to fill the vacancies in the Head Office, District and Divisional Offices of the NDRSC and to create new posts where necessary. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management to fill the vacancies in the National Disaster Relief Service Centre immediately, to assign a Disaster Relief Officer to every Divisional Secretary's Division and  to create new posts to cover essential services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of a House Rent Allowance for the families who were deprived of their houses and who had to leave their dwelling houses as a result of floods and landslides that took place in May 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - As a result of floods, landslides and cyclone that occurred in the latter part of last May, a large number of people had to suffer where 3,037 houses had been completely damaged and 25,647 houses partially.  As such, presently, facilities have been provided for in the welfare centres for families whose houses had been completely damaged and those whose houses had been damaged rendering them unsuitable for living and for those families who were removed from their dwelling houses due to the high risk of landslides.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management to make a payment of Rs.7,500/- per family, per month for the month of June, July and August to make enable those families to live in rented out houses temporarily, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of Scholarships by the Japanese Government for Human Resources Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan introduced the Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme  in Sri Lanka in the year 2010 with the objective of providing opportunities to the executive level public sector officers to follow Post Graduate studies in the recognized universities of Japan.  The Government of Japan has agreed to continue the programme which is scheduled to be completed by this year for a further period of four years. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Niroshan Perera, the Acting Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to sign the Exchange of Notes and the two Grant Agreements with the Japan International Cooperation Agency to obtain a grant of 358 million of Japanese Yen,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of District Level Committees for Religious Reconciliation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The need has arisen for a proper mechanism to be adopted island-wide for the establishment of national integration, reconciliation, co‑existence and sustainable peace. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of National Integration and Reconciliation to appoint District Level Reconciliation Committees  representing inter‑religious leaders, the Superintendent of Police of the area and any others in the area actively engaged in promoting national integration and reconciliation, convened by the District Secretary, to vest such Committees with authority to take appropriate measures to resolve the religious and ethnic tensions peacefully and to appoint a National Level Reconciliation Committee in addition to the District Level Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Office of the Medical Officer of Health (MOH) at Wadugoda, Payagala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration, the MOH Offices presently available in the Kalutara District and the population in the Payagala area, the construction of a MOH Office has become a matter of importance for focusing special attention on the  implementation of specially the programmes pertaining to maternal and child health, non communicable deceases and dengue prevention. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to construct a MOH Office in the Wagugoda area in Payagala, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Nurses Training Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- Presently, there are about 34000 Nursing Officers serving in the Government Hospitals around the island.  The modernization of the Nurses Training Schools is a timely need and it has also been found that the educational and administrative buildings of 14 Nurses Training Schools and in addition, the quarters of  certain Training Schools as well, have to be constructed expeditiously.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to commence the construction work of the educational and administrative buildings of the Nurses Training Schools in Galle, Kandy and Anuradhapura, expeditiously, utilizing the provision of Rs.200 million set apart for the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Projects aimed at enhancing digital literacy and infrastructure development and the promotion of Digital Economy and Good Governance and related Policies: 2016 - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure has planned to implement 18 projects within the period from 2016 - 2018 under the programme for digitalization of economy.  



Out of the said projects, the 10 projects which exceeds Rs. 20 million for implementation within the provision set apart for the Ministry for the year 2017 have been identified and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to implement the projects so identified, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Access to lands for Housing and Human Settlement Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- Land is a limited resource and as such, it has to be utilized with frugality and fruitfully. Due to the various limitations prohibiting the use of paddy lands for purposes other than agriculture, the development of human settlements especially in the areas subject to rapid urbanization has caused much concern. As such, the need has arisen for the use of abandoned and barren paddy lands as compatible with the town development plans and without giving way for the emergence of environmental problems for human settlements.  

	Taking note of the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction in this respect, the Cabinet decided to appoint a Committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant Ministries and other Government Institutions to decide on the methodology to be adopted with regard to the under utilized portions of lands and abandoned and barren paddy lands when such lands are given over for construction activities while also retaining the formal safety measures pertaining to environmental protection.

description: Providing safe drinking water in the Model and Reawakened Village areas in the Districts affected by the Chronic Kidney Disease of unknown etiology (CKDUE)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The model and reawakened village development programme launched by the Ministry of Housing and Construction is implemented successfully in all Districts of Sri Lanka and when providing houses under this programme special attention is focused on families affected by the  Chronic Kidney Disease of unknown etiology. However, problems have cropped up due to the absence of safe drinking water and the inadequacy of the available water supply programmes in certain areas  where this programme is implemented. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction to provide drinking water necessary to the housing projects implemented in the 11 Districts affected by the CKDUE expeditiously, with the coordination of the National Community Water Supply Department and the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Switzerland and Sri Lanka on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice  to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Switzerland and Sri Lanka with the objective of improving the effectiveness of the law enforcement of both parties in matters pertaining to investigation, prosecution and prevention of crime and the confiscation of criminal proceeds and subsequently for ratification of the MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the Annual Meeting of the International Rubber Study Group for the year 2018 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The International rubber study group commenced its activities as an Inter-Governmental Organization comprising of rubber producing and consuming stakeholders in the year 1944 and by now, it comprises of 36 member countries including Sri Lanka and 120 industry members. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Disanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to provide facilities to conduct the next Annual General Meeting of the Inter-Governmental Organization in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New two storey laboratory building for the Coconut Research Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The need for the development of the laboratory facilities of the Coconut Research Institute to the level of international standards has arisen in order to effectively contribute, to the development of the coconut industry of Sri Lanka.       

	Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon. Navin Disanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to construct a two storey building at an estimated cost of Rs.47 million for the establishment of a state of the art laboratory for the Coconut Research Institute of Sri Lanka, and out of which Rs.23 million to be obtained from the Consolidated Fund and the balance of Rs.24 million to be incurred from the earnings of the Sri Lanka Coconut Research Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of garbage in the Nuwara Eliya District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The waste collected in the town of Nuwara Eliya and the suburbs is disposed in various places of the Nuwara Eliya District and the absence of a formal methodology for waste management has resulted in various health hazards while  it has also affected the environmental beauty of the Nuwara Eliya area adversely.  

	In order to avert this situation, the need for the implementation of formal waste management programmes have been identified, and 02 Regional Plantation Companies have expressed their willingness to release the blocks of land required for the purpose.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Disanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to implement 02 Waste Management Programmes in such land, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of a block of land within the Welipatanwila Fishery Harbour premises for a Yacht construction facility
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- Even though the Fishery Habour Corporation has entered into an Agreement in the year 2014 to provide a block of land in extent of 01 acre and 6.4 perches within the Beruwala Harbour premises to the Building a Future Foundation (BAFF) Company registered under the Board of Investment which has already commenced its business activities in the Koggala Industrial Estate, for the construction of yachts to be used for passenger transport to support the tourist industry and recreational and sports activities, it has not been possible to hand over the land up to date as a result of the inability to get the consent of the fishing community to this arrangement. 
     
	As such, a site called Muththalagahalanda in Ussangoda situated in close proximity to the Welipatanwila Fishery Anchorage in the Ambalantota Divisional Secretary's Division has been selected as an alternative land  suitable for locating this project and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to hand over the land in extent of 01 acre to the company concerned, on lease basis, based on the Government Valuation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of the land at Muthurajawela in extent of 2 Acres - 0 Rood - 11 Perches to the Dart Global Logistics (Pvt.) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation has developed approximately 400 acres of land in Muthurajawela using sea sand and given it over for various investment projects and state sector projects. Three blocks of land in Muthurajawela have already been given over for logistics related activities and applications have been called for another two blocks of land to be given over for similar projects.  

	Accordingly, 30 applications have been received from interested parties and the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to lease the block of land in extent of 2 Acres - 0 Rood - 11 Perches on a 30 year lease to the Dart Global Logistics (Pvt.) Ltd. the highest bidder for the land, subject to the relevant conditions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Institute of Real Estate and Valuation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The Institute of Real Estate and Valuation (IREV) has been established in the year 2001 with the objective of fostering professionalism in real estate with specific focus on management, marketing, development, investment and valuation and it has been registered under the Companies Act. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development to establish the Institute by a Parliamentary Act in order to carry out its objectives in a more effective manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Environmental Wellness Ayurveda Village and the Research Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - With the underlying concept of establishing a treatment village and a research and educational centre of International and National Standards making use of the Ayurvedic Medical Systems, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to establish a Sri Lanka Environmental Wellness Ayurveda Village and a Research Centre at the Meddewatta area of the Mathugama Divisional Secretary's Division in the Kalutara District where it is considered as suitable to be constructed and to implement the project under Public Private Partnership basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowerment and Streamlining the Regulation Mechanism of the Community Based Organizations (CBOs), registered under the Department of National Community Water Supply (DNCWS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - Around 90% of the population of Sri Lanka has the facilities for having safe drinking water and out of which 46% fulfill their needs through pipe borne supplies. The National Water Supply & Drainage Board undertakes the supply of 35% of the pipe borne water and the balance of 11% is covered by the community based water projects. Taking into consideration, the necessity of state intervention for the regulation and settlement of issues which had arisen as a result of these projects implemented by the community, the Department of National Community Water Supply was established in 2014.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to register the community projects which supply water for the rural community under the department and to establish 'community based co‑ordinating units' at Divisional and District level for the regulation of such community based organizations, was approved by the Cabinet. The Cabinet also noted the submissions made by the Minister that an awareness programme has been organized from 20th to 23rd of June, 2017 for the representatives of the  community based organizations and the public officers, in this regard.

description: Measures taken to limit the usage of (Hydroflurocarbons - HFC) for the protection of the Ozone Layer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The Ozone layer acts as a shield preventing the harmful ultra violet rays falling on the earth and ensure protection of all living beings and plants. The global community having considered the urgent necessity of regulating and the gradual phasing out of the use of the chemical substances that damage the Ozone Layer, established the Vienna Convention and subsequently, the Montreal Protocol in 1987.  The last amendment to the Montreal Protocol was carried out on 15th October, 2015 in Kigali, Rwanda and at this Convention all parties expressed their willingness over the gradual phasing out of Hydroflurocarbons - HFC.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, for Sri Lanka to appoint a Committee to plan out the activities for the ratification of the amendment expeditiously and thereafter, to ratify the amendment by Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of the Minamata Convention on Mercury
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - By now, 128 countries including Sri Lanka have signed the Minamata Convention on Mercury to minimize the global harmful effects of its usage     while 53 countries have ratified it. With the ratification of this Convention, Sri Lanka will be afforded with the opportunity of participating as a Party at the conference, making formal representations directly to the Secretariat to the Convention, and work in collaboration with other countries being sensitive to global environmental issues. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment for Sri Lanka to ratify the Minamata Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a three storey building with General Facilities for Defence Services Viru Daru Vidupiyasa, Kurunegala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The three storey building constructed by the Sri Lanka Navy with a provision of Rs.215 million allocated by the Ministry of Education for the Defence Services Viru Daru Vidupiyasa, Kurunegala, was declared open for the students  in the month of March. However, as the building does not provide other essential facilities for educational as well as extra curricular activities, such as science labs, libraries, an auditorium, computer labs, etc. the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to construct a three storey building equipped with general facilities so as to avert such shortcomings, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The establishment of a 'Sri Lanka Cultural Centre' in New Delhi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a unique country rich in various resonating cultural aspects originating from within the country itself. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to conduct discussions with the relevant authorities of India to obtain a sufficient block of land to set up a 'Sri Lanka Cultural Centre' in New Delhi to utilize it as a venue to promote the unique cultural identity of Sri Lanka through Sri Lankan dance performances and Sri Lankan music, inclusive of the Sri Lankan traditional arts and crafts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Present developments in the Gulf Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted the information provided by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to the Cabinet on the prevailing state of affairs as a result of the breaking of diplomatic ties with the State of Qatar by the countries of Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Egypt, Bahrain and Yemen.

description: Establishment of a Buddhist Stupa in New Delhi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The Buddhist Vihara established, presently, in New Delhi is governed by the Mahabodhi Society and the temple is located within a limited space. A Buddhist Stupa or adequate facilities are not found there for the pilgrims who arrive in New Delhi from Sri Lanka and other Buddhist countries.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to conduct discussions with the relevant authorities of the Government of India to an adequate block of land to construct a Buddhist Stupa in New Delhi, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Sinhala Language Teaching Unit at the Jawaharlal Nehru University -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to conduct discussions with the Government of India for the establishment of a Unit for teaching of the Sinhala Language at the School of Language, Literature and Cultural Studies in the Jawaharlal Nehru University, with a view to providing an opportunity for the students of India and the students of other regions inclusive of the SAARCK region interested in studying the Sinhala Language, Literature and the culture of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of garbage accumulated in certain areas due to the sudden disaster situation which prevailed recently
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - As a result of the torrential rains that fell on certain areas of the Island during the 25th and 26th of May, 2017, lives were lost and damages were caused to several properties due to the floods and landslides. Waste and garbage have been accumulated in large quantities in the disaster affected areas and the health sectors have pointed out the importance of disposing of such waste expeditiously.  As the vehicles and equipment belonging to the institutions of the Provincial Councils are inadequate to dispose of the huge quantities of such accumulated garbage, the joint proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management and Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government to provide an additional provision in a sum of Rs.100 million for the purchase of the vehicles and the equipment necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Sri Lankan Presidential Task Force for the Prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease and the Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organization to conduct studies and research on the Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - It has been found that the Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology is now prevalent in 60 Divisional Secretariat Divisions of 11 Districts. The Cabinet noted that during the state visit of H.E. the President to Australia from 24th of May to 26th of May, H.E. the President has signed the MoU between the Sri Lankan Presidential Task Force for the Prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease and the Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organization to  obtain assistance of Nephrologists in Australia and make use of the Australian Nuclear Science and Technology infrastructure facilities to carry out studies and research pertaining to the disease.

description: Development of the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body:
- The Sugathadasa National Sports Complex provides sports infrastructure facilities for sports competitions at both the National and International level. This is governed by the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority and certain measures have been taken periodically for the renovation of the sports complex which has been constructed about 25 years ago. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports to carry out the implementation of the following programmes to develop the complex more comprehensively, was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	Installation of a Solar Power Generation System;

*	Repairing of the electricity supply wire system and the other equipment of the Flood Light Towers which provides electricity for the out door stadium; and

*	Modification of the Light system and the Sound System in the main stadium.

description: Strengthening of the Capital of the People's Bank by Rs.5.0 Billion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - A period of about 55 years have been elapsed by now, since the commencement of the People's Bank and the total consolidated assets owned by the Bank as of now has increased up to Rs.1.4 trillion. It has been ranked as the 387th Bank among the Asian Banks and according to domestic grading the Bank is also the second largest Bank in the country. Presently, the Bank has a total of 737 service centres and the total customer accounts are close upon  Rs.18.0 million. Considering the regulations existing in the Field of Banking, supervision and the risks involved, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development to increase the Capital of the People's Bank by Rs.5.0 billion under the monitoring of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka to suit the standards set by the Basel III Committee for the regulation of the Capital Assets of the  Banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Dedicated Economic Centre in the Eastern Province and obtaining Consultancy Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - A financial provision of Rs.300 million has been set apart by the budget proposal of 2017 for the construction of a Dedicated Economic Centre in the Eastern Province and a potion of state owned land located at Kalawanchikudy - Manmunai South Divisional Secretariat Division has been identified as suited for the purpose with the concurrence of the relevant officers and the political authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, for the selected land of 02 acres and 03 roods to be vested with the Ministry of Rural Economy and to award the contract for the construction on Design, Construction and Turn Key basis to the well experienced Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) which has already  constructed 10 Economic Centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Seed Conservation Division of the Plant Genetic Resource Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a country endowed with a high biodiversity.  With the aim of  conservation of biodiversity, the Plant Genetic Resource Centre had been established at Gannoruwa with the financial assistance of the Japanese Cooperation Fund in 1989 and by now, 14500 samples of plants have been conserved in the Plant Genetic Resource Bank.  This Genetic Resource Bank provides a high contribution for the upliftment of the national agriculture by providing such conserved crops to the Research Officers and the farmers engaged in traditional agriculture for breeding new high yielding varieties with proven resistance to climatic changes, diseases and pesticides. The Genetic Resource Centre comprises of a conservation Unit with 16 Cool Rooms and the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to obtain the necessary funds from the General Treasury for updating the technology used for functioning of the cooling systems according to the standards set by the International Conventions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an integrated project by the Department of Agriculture, Sri Lanka and the Lal Teer Seed Ltd., of Bangladesh for  increasing the production of improved varieties of  vegetable seeds
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Even though, the Department of Agriculture and several Institutions of the private sector are engaged in seed production activities, these institutions have failed to supply the total demand for the improved seed varieties adaptable to the climatic conditions of the country and as such, the demand is met with a large quantity of imported seeds. As a solution to the problem, it has been planned to implement an integrated project at the Mahailuppallama Field Crops Research and Development Centre with the Lal Teer Seed Ltd. of Bangaladesh which produces high quality seeds and which has the potential for research and development. The funds necessary for the project will be provided for by the Company and the Department of Agriculture will supply the land needed for the purpose. The technical know-how and the genetic resources available with the two parties will be utilized  in this process. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture to sign the relevant Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), to implement the proposed integrated project  and to empower the Director General of Agriculture to sign the MoU  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of additional space for the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Recently, the inadequacy of resources of the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources has affected the activities of the Department adversely and in order to be in line with the rapid and  positive changes that occurred in the  Fisheries Sector in the recent past, it has become necessary to change the  organizational structure and the present staff composition and moving to a building with adequate space. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to construct a four storey building with a capacity of 432 sq.m. of accommodation by expanding the proposed building to accommodate several divisions of the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources and to obtain the required financial provision from the Budget Estimate of 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Additional provision required for increasing the financial assistance given  to the needy artistes from Rs.5,000/- to Rs.10,000/-
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - This matter was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on 06th December 2016 and the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, therein, to increase the financial assistance given to the needy artistes from Rs.5,000/- to Rs.10,000/-, to increase the number of artistes who receive the assistance up to 5,000 and  to implement the programme from the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy and Strategic Framework on Accident Prevention and Management in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - As a result of injuries that take place in Sri Lanka, more than 1 million people are hospitalized annually and a considerable amount of provisions set apart annually for the health sector, have to be spent on them. It has been identified that the major cause of injuries is 'road traffic accidents' and the findings show that the most who die of such accidents are persons between the age of 15 to 44. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to accept the National Policy and Strategic Framework on Accident Prevention and Management in Sri Lanka formulated in order to address the situation and to get the political and the institutional cooperation desired for the implementation of the  National Policy and the Strategic Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of obesity among the School Children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the predominant health problem faced by Sri Lanka is in regard to non-communicable diseases such as heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetics, cancer etc. Recent findings show that in Sri Lanka the non‑communicable diseases account for 59% of the total deaths and the most of those who succumbed are below the age of 60 years. Since there is a trend for obesity even among the adolescents due to not being engaged in physical exercises, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to implement a new programme with the recommendations of the Ministry of Education which would pave the way to encourage the school children to be engaged in physical activities more and more during the school hours, and for them to have more facilities to get the food items which are conducive  to their health, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reformulated 'National Policy on Sanitation'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The National Policy on Sanitation was submitted to the Cabinet earlier and for the implementation of same more effectively, the policy has been reformulated incorporating the observations of the relevant stakeholders interested in the matter, the experts in the field as well as the Ministers of Finance; Megapolis and Western Development; and Education and also taking into consideration the observations of the National Steering Committee appointed to improve  the content. The policy so reformulated and submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the State Forestry Administration of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Sustainable Development and Wildlife of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between China and Sri Lanka to provide training and educational opportunities for the staff members of the Department of Wildlife Conservation in Sri Lanka. Through this programme a larger number of officers of the Department of Wildlife Conservation will get a valuable opportunity to enhance their knowledge and build up their skills. Further, opportunities will be provided for the training of officers in the relevant field, and also for them to gain experiences of the relevant field with tours arranged in both countries, to implement collaborative research programmes and also for the exchange of animal and plants and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of  Sustainable Development and Wildlife to sign the above MoU during his scheduled official visit to the People's Republic of China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Relief to the victims of floods and landslides
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30

description: Reinsurance cover for National Natural Disaster and Emergency Relief Insurance Scheme for the year 2017/18
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - In a Budget Proposal for the year 2016 an insurance scheme has been introduced under the National Insurance Trust Fund to protect the entire country against natural disasters such as Cyclones, Storms, Tempests, Floods, Landslides, Hurricanes, Earthquakes, Tsunami and other similar natural disasters. In this context, a sum of Rs.500 million has been set apart in the Budget of 2017 to develop this Insurance Scheme as a more productive one enhancing the benefits which could be derived from the present insurance scheme. Accordingly, providing of benefits have been more enlarged including insurance coverage for loss of life due to lightning, falling objects on individuals, property damage due to falling of trees caused by heavy winds, collapse of retaining walls caused by heavy rain, permanent disability caused by natural disasters etc. Under this insurance scheme the National Insurance Trust Fund has provided an insurance coverage of Rs.15 billion and therefore, a re-insurance  has to be obtained with the objective of preventing an unusual loss for the fund. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to select a re-insurance company in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to pay the due installments in that regard and to enter into the relevant Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of the import of  Concrete Pump Trucks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The construction sector represents the second largest industrial segment in Sri Lanka and by facilitating the construction industry the country can derive a considerable amount of economic and social benefits. As such, the regulations relevant to the import of concrete pump trucks necessary for construction activities have been amended and in the import of such machines two new combined classification code numbers have been introduced for the Concrete Pump Trucks which are not more than 10 years old and those which are more than 10 years old. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to present the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2019/24 of 2017-05-19 published under the Import and Export Control Act, No.01 of 1969 incorporating the importation of Concrete Pump Trucks which are more than 10 years old in the list of Items for which Import licenses should be obtained, to the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of an additional bulk of 150 MT of dates from Sathosa to be distributed among the persons of the Islamic faith during the Ramalan season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - Although, 150 MT of dates have been received as a donation from the Government of Saudi Arabia for the persons of the Islamic faith  to be used during the  Ramalan season, it has been assessed that the quantity will not be sufficient for the consumption such persons during the period. As such, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs for Sathosa to purchase a stock of 150 MT of dates  in addition to the stock of donation received presently and distribute same among the persons of the Islamic faith under the supervision of the Ministry of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Official Residences for Public Officers - Colombo District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - A large number of Government Institutions are established within the Colombo District and since a considerable number of officers serving in these institutions are residents living outside the Colombo District, they expect official residences for them. Even though, some number of residences owned by the  Ministry of Public Administration and Management have been provided for the executive grade of the public service and other officers due to exigencies of service, providing residences for officers like the Secretaries to Ministries and Heads of Departments has paused a problem due to the dearth of such official residences. As a solution to the problem a project has been planned to construct a 08 story building to house 49 official residences in a portion of land in extent of 0.2840 hectares belonging to the Ministry of Public Administration and Management located at Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07 where the office of the  Land Reform Commission was established previously and the project is due to commence this year and complete by the end of 2019. As such the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to implement the relevant project and to obtain the funds necessary for the purpose from the General Treasury within the period of 2017 - 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for the construction of 500 houses on design & construction basis for Professionals at Weera Mawatha, Pannipitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development has planned to implement a project for the construction of 500 houses for the Professionals at Weera Mawatha, Pannipitiya. This project has been planned to be implemented with the funds obtained as house value in advance from the selected recipients of the houses. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development,  to implement the project in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for the construction of the Road from Lunugala to Bibila (from 171.80 km to 190.80 km) under the Badulla - Chenkalady Road Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways,  to award the contract for the construction of the Road from Lunugala to Bibila (from 171.80 km to 190.80 km) under the Badulla - Chenkalady Road Improvement Project as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 2018 - ආසියානු සමුද්‍ර කලාපීය රාජ්‍යයන්හි ස්ථාපිත තහනම් උත්තේජක මර්දන ආයතනයන්හි සමුළුව සඳහා සත්කාරකත්වය ලබා දීම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - 2018 වර්ෂයේදී පැවත්වීමට නියමිත ආසියානු සමුද්‍ර කලාපීය රාජ්‍යයන්හි ස්ථාපිත තහනම් උත්තේජක මර්දන ආයතනයන්හි සමුළුව ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේදී පැවැත්වීමට ලෝක තහනම් උත්තේජක මර්දන ආයතනය විසින් ඉල්ලීමක් ඉදිරිපත් කර ඇත. මෙම සමුළුව සඳහා ලෝක තහනම් උත්තේජක මර්දන ආයතනයේ සාමාජිකයින්, ආසියානු ඔලිම්පික් කමිටු සාමාජිකයින්, ජාතික ඔලිම්පික් කමිටු සාමාජිකයින් සහ ශ්‍රී ලංකා විද්වතුන් ඇතුළුව 150ක් සහභාගීවීමට නියමිත අතර ඔවුන් සඳහා දේශීය  සත්කාරකත්වය ලබා දිය යුතු වේ. ඒ අනුව, අදාළ සමුළුව 2018 වර්ෂයේදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ සත්කාරකත්වය යටතේ පැවැත්වීමටත්, ඒ සඳහා රුපියල් මිලියන 20ක ඇස්තමේන්තුගත පිරිවැයක් දැරීමට හා අවශ්‍ය ප්‍රතිපාදන 2018 වර්ෂයේදී ලබාගැනීමටත් ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍ය දයාසිරි ජයසේකර මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Hosting the Conference of the organizations of Anti - doping in Sports  established in the countries of Asia - Oceania Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: The World Anti-doping Agency has made a request to host the conference of the organizations of Anti - doping in Sports  established in the countries of Asia - Oceania Region scheduled to be held in 2018 in Sri Lanka. 150 members consisting of 120 delegates from the World Anti-doping Agency, Asian Olympic Committee including 30 professionals of Sri Lanka are due to participate in this conference for whom local hosting facilities should be afforded. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to host the said conference in Sri Lanka in the year 2018 under the hospitality of Sri Lanka, to bear an estimated expenditure in a  sum of Rs.20 million and to obtain the necessary funds in the year 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 1924 අංක 4 දරන ගංවතුර ආරක්ෂණ ආඥාපනත අහෝසිකර නව ගංවතුර කළමනාකරණ පනතක් ස්ථාපිත කිරීම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - ගංවතුරින් හානි සිදු විය හැකි ප්‍රදේශ ප්‍රකාශයට පත් කිරීම පිණිස 1924 අංක 4 දරන ගංවතුර ආරක්ෂණ ආඥාපනතින් විෂයභාර අමාත්‍යවරයාට බලය පැවරී ඇති අතර, එම ප්‍රදේශ ආරක්ෂා කිරීම පිණිස අවශ්‍ය පියවර ගැනීමේ බලය වාරිමාර්ග අධ්‍යක්ෂ ජනරාල් වෙත පැවරී ඇත. මෙම පනත එක් වතාවකදී පමණක් සුළු වශයෙන් සංශෝධනය වී ඇති අතර පසුගිය කාලය තුළ සිදු වී ඇති සමාජ, ආර්ථික, පාරිසරික, දේශගුණික හා ආයතනික වෙනස්කම් සැලකිල්ලට ගෙන, වර්තමාන හා අනාගත අවශ්‍යතාවන්ට ගැලපෙන පරිදි ගංගා සහ ජලාශවලින් ඇති විය හැකි ගංවතුර ආපදා මෙන්ම වැසි ජලය එක් රැස්වීම නිසා සිදුවන නාගරික හා ප්‍ර‍ාදේශීය ආපදා සහ වෙනත් ආකාරයේ ජල ගැලීම්වලින් සිදු වන ආපදාවලින් ජිවිත, දේපළ, පරිසරය හා ආර්ථිකයට සිදුවිය හැකි හානි හා ආපදා අවම කිරීමට හැකි වන පරිදි විධිවිධාන ඇතුළත් ගංවතුර ආරක්ෂණ පනතක් පැනවීමේ අවශ්‍යතාව මතු වී ඇත. ඒ අනුව, 1924 අංක 4 දරන ගංවතුර ආරක්ෂණ ආඥාපනත අහෝසිකර නව පනතක් කෙටුම්පත් කිරීම පිණිස වාරිමාර්ග හා ජලසම්පත් කළමනාකරණ අමාත්‍ය විජිත් විජයමුණි සොයිසා මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Repealing the Flood Protection Ordinance, No.4 of 1924 and enacting a new Flood Management Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The Minister in charge of the subject is empowered to declare areas that can be affected by floods under the Flood Protection Ordinance, No.4 of 1924 and the  authority to take appropriate measures for the protection of such areas has been vested with the Director of Irrigation. This Ordinance has been subject to  a minor amendment only once. Considering the social, economic, environmental, climatic and institutional changes that had taken place during the past a necessity has now arisen to address the present and future eventualities by enacting a new Flood Management Act incorporating provision to minimize the damages which my be caused to lives, property, environment and the economy from the adverse effects of flood disasters caused by rivers and reservoirs and as well as urban and local storm waters and various other causes.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to draft a new Flood Management Bill repealing the Flood Protection Ordinance, No.4 of 1924, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ කෘෂිකාර්මික පර්යේෂණ ප්‍රතිපත්ති සභාව (SLCARP) සහ මැලේසියාවේ කෘෂිකාර්මික පර්යේෂණ සංවර්ධන ආයතනය (MARDI) සමඟ ජාතික කෘෂිකර්ම පර්යේෂණ පද්ධතියේ විද්‍යාඥයින්ගේ මානව සම්පත් සංවර්ධනය සම්බන්ධයෙන් අත්සන් කර ඇති අවබෝධතා ගිවිසුම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - 2016 වර්ෂයේදී අතිගරු ජනාධිපතිතුමා විසින් මැලේසියාවේදී සිදු කරනු ලැබූ නිල සංචාරය අතරතුර ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ කෘෂිකාර්මික පර්යේෂණ ප්‍රතිපත්ති සභාව (SLCARP) සහ මැලේසියාවේ කෘෂිකාර්මික පර්යේෂණ සංවර්ධන ආයතනය (MARDI) සමඟ ජාතික කෘෂිකර්ම පර්යේෂණ පද්ධතියේ විද්‍යාඥයින්ගේ මානව සම්පත් සංවර්ධනය සම්බන්ධයෙන් අවබෝධතා ගිවිසුමකට එළඹ ඇත. එම අවබෝධතා ගිවිසුම මඟින් දෙපාර්ශ්වය අතර තාක්ෂණික සහයෝගය ඉහළ නංවා ගැනීමටත්, පශ්චාත් උපාධි සහිත විද්‍යාඥයින් බිහි කරගැනීමටත් අවස්ථාව සැලසෙනු ඇත. එකඟතාවකට එළඹ ඇති වැඩසටහන් ක්‍රියාත්මක කිරීම සඳහා අවශ්‍ය ප්‍රතිපාදන මහා භාණ්ඩාගාරයෙන් ලබාගැනීමට හැකි වන පරිදි අදාළ අවබෝධතා ගිවිසුම අත්සන් කිරීම වෙනුවෙන් කෘෂිකර්ම අමාත්‍ය දුමින්ද දිසානායක මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් ආවරණ අනුමැතිය ලබා දෙන ලදී.

description: Memorandum of Understanding entered into between the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy (SLCARP) and the Malaysia Agricultural Research Development Institute (MARDI) for development of human resources of Agricultural Scientists in the National Agricultural Research Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - During the official visit of H.E. the President to Malaysia in the year 2016,  a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been entered into between the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy (SLCARP) and the Malaysia Agricultural Research Development Institute (MARDI) for development of human resources of Agricultural Scientists in the National Agricultural Research Systems. In accordance with the MoU an opportunity has been created to enhance the technical corporation between the two parties and also to produce scientists with post graduate degrees. In order to enable the release of  the required provision from the General Treasury for the implementation of the programmes agreed upon, the Cabinet granted covering approval for the signing of the relevant MoU as proposed by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture.

description: කොළඹ කොටුව සහ පිටකොටුව ඇතුළත පදික මංතීරු සංවර්ධනය (ඉදි කිරීම් අදියර III)
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - කොළඹ කොටුව සහ පිටකොටුව ප්‍රදේශවල පවතින අධික වාහන තදබදය සැලකිල්ලට ගෙන, පදිකයින්ට ආරක්ෂිතව ගමන් කිරීමට හැකි වන පරිදි ආකර්ශණීය ස්ථාන යා කරමින් මංතීරු ජාලයක් ඉදි කිරීමට සැලසුම් කර ඇත. මෙම ව්‍යාපෘතියේ 1 අදියර ලෙස ඩී.ආර්.විජේවර්ධන මාවතේ සිට ඕල්කට් මාවත දක්වා කොටස දැනටමත් වැඩ නිම කර ඇති අතර, අදියර 2 යටතේ ඔල්කට් මාවත සහ සමුද්‍ර මාවත අතර කොටස දැනට වැඩ නිම වෙමින් පවතී. ව්‍යාපෘතියේ අදියර 3 වශයෙන් සාන්ත සෙබස්තියන් ඇළ ටෙක්නිකල් හංදියේ සිට උපරිමාධිකරණ සංකීර්ණය දක්වා වන පදික මාරුව සංවර්ධනය කිරීමට යෝජිත අතර එය මීට‍ර් 6ක (අඩි 20ක) පළලකින් යුතු වන අතර, දිග මීටර් 1,485කි. එම අදියර III යටතේ යෝජිත ඉදි කිරීම් මහානගර හා බස්නාහිර සංවර්ධන අමාත්‍යාංශයට වෙන් කර ඇති ප්‍රතිපාදන යොදා ගනිමින් ශ්‍රී ලංකා නාවික හමුදාව මඟින් සිදු කර ගැනීම සඳහා මහානගර හා බස්නාහිර සංවර්ධන අමාත්‍ය පාඨලී චම්පික රණවක මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Development of pedestrian web in Fort and Pettah in Colombo (Construction of Stage III)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct a pedestrian web linking attractive areas to enable the pedestrians to walk safely, considering the excessive vehicle influx found in Fort and Pettah in Colombo. Stage I of this project extending from D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha to Olcott Mawatha has already been completed and the work pertaining to the Olcott Mawatha and Samudra Mawatha under Stage II is presently nearing completion. As Stage III, it is proposed to develop a pedestrian walk way of 06 meters wide (20 feet) and 1,485 meters long, along the Sebestian Canal from the Technical Junction to the Supreme Courts Complex.    Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to obtain the services of the Sri Lanka Navy to carry out the proposed construction work utilizing the provision set apart for the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, for Stage III of the Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: නව කර්මාන්ත පිහිටුවීම සඳහා ප්‍රාදේශීයව පිහිටි කර්මාන්තපුරවලින් ඉඩම් කොටස් වෙන් කර දීම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - බුත්තල, නාලන්ද (මාතලේ), නාලන්ද එල්ලාවල, ගලිගමුව, කළුතර, මිල්ලව, මිනුවන්ගොඩ, මතුගම, දඹදෙනිය, නූරාන, මාකදුර (බටහිර), දංකොටුව, උඩුකාව, ත්‍රිකුණාමලය යන කර්මාන්තපුරවල පිහිටි ඉඩම් කොටස් 23ක් රුපියල් බිලියන 1,617ක පමණ ආයෝජනය කිරීමට අපේක්ෂිත තෝරාගත් ආයෝජකයින් සඳහා ප්‍රධාන තක්සේරුකරු විසින් තීරණය කරනු ලබන බදු කුලිය අය කිරීමේ පදනම මත වසර 35ක කාලයකට බදු පදනම මත ලබා දීම සඳහා කර්මාන්ත හා වාණිජ කටයුතු අමාත්‍ය රිෂාඩ් බදියුදීන් මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Allocation of land blocks from Regional Industrial Estates to set up new Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to lease out 23 blocks of land available in the Industrial Estates of Buttala, Nalanda (Matale), Nalanda Ellawala, Galigamuwa, Kalutara, Millawa, Minuwangoda, Matugama, Dambadeniya, Nurana, Makandura (West), Dankotuwa, Udukawa and Trincomalee to the investors selected on lease term basis on payment of a lease rental determined by the Chief Government Valuer for a period of 35 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: පාකිස්තානු රජය වෙතින් ඇ.ඩො. මිලියන 200ක ණය පහසුකමක් ලබාගැනීම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - ශ්‍රී ලංකා රජයේ ප්‍රමුඛ සංවර්ධන ව්‍යාපෘති මූල්‍යයනය කිරීම සඳහා ඇමරිකන් ඩොලර් මිලියන 200ක ණය පහසුකමක් ලබා දීමට පාකිස්තානු රජය එකඟ වී ඇත. නිවාස ඉදි කිරීම, පශු සම්පත් නඟා සිටුවීමට අවශ්‍ය සතුන් ආනයනය, කෘෂිකර්මාන්තය හා කිරි නිෂ්පාදනය සඳහා අවශ්‍ය යන්ත්‍රසූත්‍ර ආනයනය, කාර්මික තාක්ෂණ ආයතනය (ITI) සංවර්ධනය කිරීම වැනි කාර්යයන් සඳහා මෙම ණය පහසුකම උපයෝගි කරගනු ඇත. ඒ අනුව, පාකිස්තානු රජය සමඟ ඊට අදාළ ණය ගිවිසුමට එළඹීම පිණිස හිටපු මුදල් අමාත්‍ය රවි කරුණානායක මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කර තිබූ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Obtaining a loan facility of US$ 200 million from the Government of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The Government of Pakistan has agreed to provide a loan facility of US$ 200 million to finance the Priority Development Projects in Sri Lanka.  This loan facility will be utilized for the construction of houses, the import of farm animals necessary for enhancing livestock activities, the import of machinery required for agriculture and dairy industry, and for the development of the Industrial Technology Institute (ITI) etc. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the then Minister of Finance, to enter into the relevant Agreement with the Government of Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: උසස් අධ්‍යාපන තත්ත්ව ආරක්ෂණ ආයතන සඳහා වූ අන්තර්ජාතික ජාලයේ මීළඟ සමුළුව 2019 වර්ෂයේදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ පැවැත්වීම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - උසස්  අධ්‍යාපන ක්ෂේත්‍රයේ තත්ත්ව ආරක්ෂණය වෙනුවෙන් ක්‍රියාකාරීව කටයුතු කරන සංවිධාන 200කට අධික සංඛ්‍යාවක එකමුතුවෙන් 'උසස්  අධ්‍යාපන තත්ත්ව ආරක්ෂණ ආයතන සඳහා වූ අන්තර්ජාතික ජාලය' ස්ථාපිත කරනු ලැබ ඇත. එහි සාමාජිකයින් විසින් අනුගමනය කරනු ලැබ ඇති වඩාත් ඵලදායී වැඩසටහන් පිළිබඳව සාකච්ඡා කරමින් අත්දැකීම් හුවමාරු කරගැනීමේ අරමුණ ඇතිව සෑම දෙවසරකට වරක් එම ජාලයේ සමුළුවක් පවත්වනු ලබයි. දේශීය හා විදේශීය පාර්ශ්වකරුවන් 1,000ක් පමණ සහභාගී වීමට නියමිත එම ජාලයේ මීළඟ සමුළුව 2019 වර්ෂයේදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේදී පැවැත්වීම පිණිස උසස් අධ්‍යාපන හා මහාමාර්ග අමාත්‍ය ලක්ෂ්මන් කිරිඇල්ල මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Hosting of the next conference of the International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education (INQAAHE) in Sri Lanka in the year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education has been established with the collaboration of over 200  organizations actively engaged in the task. A biennial conference is held to discuss the more productive programmes undertaken by the members with a view to sharing the best practices adopted by such members. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to host the next conference of the network in  Sri Lanka in the year 2019 where around 1000 local and international stakeholders are due to participate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: දුම්රිය දෙපාර්තමේන්තුවට අයත් දුම්රිය රක්ෂිත භාවිතාකරන්නන්ගෙන් අයවිය යුතු හිඟ බදු අයකර ගැනීම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - දුම්රිය දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව සතු ඉඩම්වලින් මේ වන විට අක්කර 1,934ක් පමණ බදුකරුවන් 6,400කට බදු පදනම මත ලබා දී ඇතිමුත් ඒ අතුරින්  බොහෝ දෙනෙකු එම දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව වෙත නියමිත පරිදි බදු මුදල් ගෙවා නොමැත. ඒ අනුව, රුපියල් මිලියන 1,468ක් පමණ හිඟ බදු මුදල් ලෙස අය විය යුතුව ඇත. 2016 මැයි මස 10 දින පැවති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල රැස්වීමේදී දුම්රිය දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව සතු ඉඩම් වසර 10ක් ඉක්මවා පරිහරණය කරනු ලබන පුද්ගලයින්ට රජයේ තක්සේරුව මත වසර 05ක උපරිම කාල සීමාවක් දක්වා එම ඉඩම් විධිමත් ලෙස බදු දීමට අනුමැතිය දෙන ලදී. ඒ අනුව, එලෙස විධිමත් ලෙස ඉඩම් බදු දීමේදී අදාළ ඉඩම් පරිහරණය කරනු ලබන පුද්ගලයින්ගෙන් අය විය යුතු හිඟ මුදල් අය කරගැනීම සඳහා විධිමත්, සහනදායී ක්‍රමවේදයක් හඳුන්වා දීම පිණිස ප්‍රවාහන හා සිවිල් ගුවන් සේවා අමාත්‍ය නිමල් සිරිපාල ද සිල්වා මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Recovery of lease arrears from the occupants of the railway reservations of the Department of Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - Even though nearly 1934 acres of lands out of the lands belonging to the Department of Railways have been given over to 6400 occupants on lease basis, most of the lessees have not paid their due lease rent on a regular basis to the department.  As a result, a sum of Rs.1,468 million is due as arrears. At the Cabinet meeting held on 10th of May 2016, approval was granted to lease out the lands occupied for more than 10 years to the relevant occupants for a maximum period of 5 years based on the Government Valuation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to introduce a formal and concessionary method to levy the arrears of lease from the occupants of the relevant lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: කසළ බැහැර කරන ස්ථානවල වන අලි ගැවසීම වැළැක්වීම සඳහා ක්‍රියාමාර්ග ගැනීම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - අවිධිමත් ලෙස කසළ බැහැර කිරීම පරිසරයට මෙන්ම වන සතුන්ට ද අයහපත් අන්දමට බලපා ඇත. විශේෂයෙන්ම වනජීවි කලාප තුළ කසළ බැහැර කෙරෙන ස්ථාන 54ක් පමණ තිබෙන බව හඳුනාගෙන ඇති අතර, වන අලින් 300කට අධික ප්‍රමාණයක් ඒ අවට ගැවසෙන බව ද වාර්තා වී ඇත. එම වන අලි කසළ ආහාරයට ගැනීමට හුරුවීම හේතුවෙන් එම සතුන්ගේ ජීවිතවලට බලවත් තර්ජනයක් මතු වී ඇත.  ඒ අනුව, මෙම තත්ත්වයට විසඳුමක් ලෙස තිරසර සංවර්ධන හා වනජීවී අමාත්‍යාංශය සහ පළාත් සභා හා පළාත් පාලන අමාත්‍යාංශය එක්ව, වන සතුන් බහුලව ගැවසෙන ප්‍රදේශ සඳහා ප්‍රමුඛතාවය ලබා දෙමින් කසළ ප්‍රතිචක්‍රීකරණය කිරීමේ වැඩපිළිවෙළක් සැලසුම් කර ක්‍රියාත්මක කිරීමටත්, විවෘතව කසළ බැහැර ‍කෙරෙන ස්ථානවලට වන අලින්ට ඇතුළු වීමට නොහැකි වන පරිදි තිරසර සංවර්ධන හා වනජීවී අමාත්‍යාංශය විසින් නිසි ස්ථානවල විදුලි වැට ඉදි කිරීමටත් තිරසර සංවර්ධන හා වනජීවී අමාත්‍ය ගාමිණි ජයවික්‍රම පෙරේරා මැතිතුමා සහ පළාත් සභා හා පළාත් පාලන අමාත්‍ය ෆයිසර් මුස්තාපා මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ ඒකාබද්ධ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Measures to be taken to prevent the hanging out of Wild Elephants around Waste Disposal Sites
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The improper disposal of waste has affected the environment as well as the wild animals, adversely .  It has been identified that there are 54 waste disposal yards especially in the forest zones for the disposal of waste and that over 300 wild elephants are reported roaming around these sites.  The wild elephants getting used to consume waste has resulted in pausing a serious threat to their lives.  As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife and Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to workout an integrated plan giving priority to places where the wild elephants frequent mostly for re-cycling of waste by the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government together with the Ministry of Sustainable Development and Wildlife and to erect electric fences in the proper places to prevent the entry of wild elephants to the waste disposal yards, as a solution to this issue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ශ්‍රී ලංකාව හා චීන මහජන සමූහාණ්ඩුව අතර උදර්පණ ගිවිසුම
decision_details_title: 2017-05-30 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - ගරු අග්‍රාමාත්‍යතුමා විසින් පසුගිය වසරේ චීනයේ සිදු කරන ලද නිල සංචාරය අතරතුර, අධිකරණයක වරදකරුවන් වන පුද්ගලයන් අන්‍යොන්‍ය වශයෙන් පිටුවහල් කිරීමට (උදර්පණය‍ට) අදාළව ශ්‍රී ලංකාව හා චීන මහජන සමූහාණ්ඩුව අතර ගිවිසුමකට අත්සන් තබනු ලැබ ඇත. එම උදර්පණ ගිවිසුම අත්සන් තැබීමට අදාළව, ආරක්ෂක අමාත්‍යතුමා වශයෙන් අතිගරු ජනාධිපති මෛත්‍රීපාල සිරිසේන මැතිතුමා ඉදිරිපත් කළ යෝජනාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් අනුමත කරන ලදී.

description: Extradition Treaty between Sri Lanka and the People’s Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - During the official visit of the Hon. Prime Minister to China last year, an extradition treaty has been entered into between Sri Lanka and the People's Republic of China for mutual extradition of persons convicted in a court of law. Accordingly, the reference made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, in relevance to the signing of the extradition treaty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: වැල්ලවත්ත ප්‍රදේශයේ ගොඩනැඟිල්ලක් කඩා වැටීමෙන් සිදු වූ අනතුර
decision_details_title: 2017-05-23 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body:
- වැල්ලවත්ත ප්‍රදේශයේ ඉදි කෙරෙමින් තිබූ ගොඩනැඟිල්ලක් කඩා වැටීමෙන් සිදු වූ අනතුර සම්බන්ධයෙන් අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලයේ අවධානය යොමු වූ අතර, මෙවැනි සිදුවීම් ඉදිරියේදි ඇති නොවන බව තහවුරු කිරීම පිණිස යෝග්‍ය පියවර ගැනීමේ අවශ්‍යතාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් සැලකිල්ලට ගන්නා ලදී.  
අදාළ ගොඩනැඟිල්ල ඉදි කිරීම සඳහා නීතිමය විධිවිධාන ප්‍රකාර කිසිදු අවසරයක් ලබාගෙන නොමැති බවටත්, නීතිවිරෝධී ලෙස එම ගොඩනැඟිල්ල ඉදි කිරීමට ඉඩ ලබා දීම සම්බන්ධයෙන් වගකිව යුතු  සියලුම නිලධාරින්ට එරෙහිව විධිමත් පරීක්ෂණ කටයුතු ආරම්භ කර ඇති බවටත්, එම පරීක්ෂණ කටයුතුවල ප්‍රතිඵල මත පදනම්ව වගකිව යුතු අදාළ නිලධාරින්ට එරෙහිව විනයානුකූලව කටයුතු කෙරෙන බවටත්, මින් ඉදිරියට මේ ආකාරයේ සිදුවීම් සිදු නොවන බවට වගබලා ගන්නා ලෙස අදාළ බලධාරින්ට දැනටමත් උපදෙස් ලබා දී ඇති බවටත් මහානගර හා බස්නාහිර සංවර්ධන අමාත්‍ය පාඨලී චම්පික රණවක මැතිතුමා මේ සම්බන්ධයෙන් ඉදිරිපත් කළ තොරතුරු අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් වැඩිදුරටත් සැලකිල්ලට ගන්නා ලදී.

description: Accident caused due to the collapsing of a Building at Wellawatta
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body:
- The attention of the Cabinet was focused on the accident caused by the collapsing of a building which was under construction at Wellawatta area and the Cabinet noted the need to take appropriate measures to ensure that the incidents of this nature would not occur in future.   

The Cabinet noted further, the information provided in this regard by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, that the relevant approval from the authorities concerned has not been obtained in accordance with the norms and standards of building construction for the construction of that building, that formal investigation has been initiated against all officers responsible for allowing to construct the building illegally in such manner, that disciplinary action will be taken against the officers concerned based on the findings of the investigation and that instructions have already been given to the authorities concerned to ensure that no such incidents of this nature occur in future.

decision_details_title: 2017-05-23 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body:
- මෑතකදී රටේ ස්ථාන කිහිපයක සිදු වූ, ජනවර්ග අතර සමඟියට බාධා වන අකාරයේ සිදුවීම් හා ඇතැම් පාර්ශ්වයන්ගේ ප්‍රකෝපකාරී හැසිරීම් පිළිබඳව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලයේ අවධානය යොමු වූ අතර, එවැනි සිදුවීම් හා හැසිරීම් ඉදිරියේදී ඇති නොවීමට අදාළ යෝග්‍ය පියවර ගැනීමේ අවශ්‍යතාව අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් සැලකිල්ලට ගන්නා ලදී.  ඒ අනුව, අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් පහත පරිදි තීරණය කරන ලදී: 
(i)	රට තුළ වෙසෙන ජනවර්ග අතර සමඟියට බාධා වන අකාරයේ සිදුවීම් සඳහා වගකිව යුතු පාර්ශ්වයන්ට එරෙහිව, පවතින නීතියේ විධිවිධාන ප්‍රකාර නීතිමය පියවර ගැනීම සඳහා නීතිය ක්‍රියාත්මක කරන අදාළ බලධාරින්ට උපදෙස් දීම. 
(ii)   එවැනි සිදුවීම් තම බල ප්‍රදේශය තුළ  ඇති නොවීමට වගබලා ගන්නා ලෙස සියලුම පොලිස් ස්ථානාධිපතිවරුන්ට උපදෙස් දෙන ලෙස පොලිස්පතිවරයාට නියම කිරීම.

description: Incidents hampering the peaceful co-existence among ethnic communities in the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body:
- The attention of the Cabinet was focused on incidents hampering the peaceful co-existence among the ethnic communities and some provocative behaviour of certain parties which had taken place recently in several places of the country. The Cabinet noted the necessity of taking relevant appropriate measures to ensure that recurrence of  such incidents and behaviour do not occur in the future.  Accordingly, the Cabinet decided as follows: 
(i)	to direct the law enforcement authorities to take legal action in accordance with the legal provision against those who are responsible for incidents hampering the peaceful co-existence among communities; and 

(ii)	to direct the Inspector General of Police to instruct the Officers-In-Charge of all Police Stations to ensure that recurrence of such  incidents do not take place within their area of authority.

decision_details_title: 2017-05-23 දිනැති අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල තීරණය පිලිබඳ මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශය
decision_details_body: - දේශීය වෙළඳ පොළෙහි සහල් මිල ශීඝ්‍රයෙන් ඉහළ යාම සම්බන්ධයෙන් අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලයේ අවධානය යොමු වූ අතර, ඒ පිළිබඳව දීර්ඝ වශයෙන්  කරුණු සාකච්ඡා කරන ලදී. ඒ අනුව, දේශීය වී ගොවීන්ට අහිතකර බලපෑමක් සිදු නොවන පරිදි සහ පාරිභෝගිකයින්ට පහසු මිලකට සහල් මිල දී ගැනීමට හැකිවන පරිදි සහල් ආනයනය කිරීමට පෞද්ගලික අංශයට අවසර දීම පිණිස අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් තීරණය කරන ලදී. එසේ ආනයනය කළ යුතු සහල් ප්‍රමාණය, ජීවන වියදම පිළිබඳ අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩල අනුකාරක සභාව විසින් තීරණය කරනු ලැබිය යුතු බව ද අමාත්‍ය මණ්ඩලය විසින් වැඩිදුරටත් තීරණය කරන ලදී.

description: Increase in the price of rice in the domestic market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Cabinet was focused on the steep rise in the price of rice in the domestic market and the matter was discussed at length. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant approval to import rice through the private sector importers to enable the consumers to obtain rice at an affordable price without causing an adverse impact on the local paddy farmers.  Cabinet further decided that the quantum of rice to be so imported should be determined by the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Cost of Living.
